title: List tab groups
when: Find groupId, windowId and tabIds before changing an existing group.

title: Create a tab group
when: Group your current page. Replace research with your task label; keep the returned groupId. The tab stays in the group your script creates; automatic grouping never moves it or retitles, collapses or closes that group. Your script owns cleanup. With automatic grouping, other session tabs still use the automatic group, so both groups can appear in one window.

title: Retitle or recolour a tab group
when: Set groupId from the group list. Change title, color or collapsed; omitted fields stay unchanged. Colors are grey, blue, red, yellow, green, pink, purple, cyan and orange.
code: return await neo.cdp('Browser.updateTabGroup', { groupId, title: 'research notes', color: 'blue', collapsed: false });

title: Add tabs to a group
when: Set groupId from the group list and tabIds from page.tabId values. Adding moves those tabs into that group.

title: Remove tabs from a group
when: Set tabIds from page.tabId values. The tabs stay open; removing the last tab destroys the empty group.

title: Close a tab group
when: Set groupId from the group list. This closes every tab in that group; inspect its tabIds first. The server never retitles, collapses or closes a group your script creates; your script owns cleanup. Other session tabs can be in a separate automatic group in the same window, so check which group you are closing. Never include Neo's reserved blank tab. Protected tab/window closes report script / unsupported; leave the reserved tab and window open rather than using group closure to bypass that refusal.

title: List windows
when: Find windowId and the active tab. liveBrowserContextId identifies a loaded profile; browserContextId is only a legacy label.

title: Open a window
when: Open an inactive normal window. To choose a loaded profile, pass its browserContextId from the profile list.

title: Close a window
when: Set windowId from the window list. This closes all tabs in that window; inspect it first. Neo keeps its own reserved blank tab open. A close that would remove that tab or its window is refused as script / unsupported; the close is not sent. Leave the reserved window open and close only your own pages with page.close(), or use a separate window. Do not bypass the refusal.

title: Open a tab in a chosen window
when: Set windowId from the window list and url to the destination. In the next run, find the returned tabId in context.pages() to use Playwright on it. Placement is per call, with no saved window binding.
code: const { tab } = await neo.cdp('Browser.createTab', { windowId, url, background: true }); return { tabId: tab.tabId };

title: List profiles
when: Discover saved regular profiles without loading them. browserProfileId is a saved-profile handle; browserContextId identifies a loaded profile and expires on browser restart.

title: Load a profile
when: Set browserProfileId from the profile list. Loading opens no window and changes no task binding. Use the returned profile.browserContextId when creating a window in that profile.

title: Read recent history
when: Read up to 20 recent entries. To choose a loaded profile, pass its browserContextId from the profile list.

title: Bring a tab to the front
when: Use the page you intend to show. This selects that tab in its window.
